reviews.text: Loyal clients for 1.5 years and things started off very strong here however disappointed at the slow decline in customer service more recently. The phone lines have issues constantly making it very hard to discuss or reschedule bookings and it seems they are no longer putting bandanas or bow ties as part of the groom (which is fine if this change is communicated to customers). To top it off, it is very challenging to speak to a manager and there is no one working the front desk lately, making things unnecessarily chaotic. There is no way to provide reference notes in the system for the groomer to ensure there is no confusion about groom specifications - today this meant my pup did not receive the style requested and this will take months of grow out before I can rebook a photo session I had planned this week. The groomers are very talented and skilled but there are lots of other spots nearby- might be worth it to steer clear so that this business can adjust its quality of admin/service.
They went above and beyond!
Friendly and efficient.  More importantly,  my dog enjoys his visits there.  Iris is the best.

the young man at the front desk was super helpful and kind! the store is also sooo cute i love it

We had an appointment at 11 AM and called ahead to let the store know we were running late, asking if a 11:15–11:20 arrival would still work. They confirmed it was fine. When my husband arrived at 11:20, staff refused to see us and claimed we had never called — which was simply not true. While we understand we were behind schedule, being told over the phone that a late arrival was acceptable, only to be turned away and have the call denied, is extremely frustrating and unprofessional. To make matters worse, a staff member had told my husband the grooming would be completed in 60 minutes — which is not a realistic timeframe for a 65-pound German Shepherd.

Update: owner reached out and is very proactive on improving their overall management on their end, hope this won’t happen to other people and pets visiting.

Such wonderful humans who took such great care of her. We will be back again soon !

Poor customer service!! Not a way to run your business at all! It's impossible to leave a voice message as their voicemail is not set up. When I finally was able to reach the store, they scheduled an appointment for my cat at 10am on Sunday. The lady assured me that Iris would be there and would cut my cat's nails in 5 minutes.  When I arrived with my cat in his carrier, the girl indicated they had no appointment on file for my cat and that the groomer Iris wouldn't be in until 10:30am! She asked if I could come back. Obviously, no experience with cats in carriers and clueless. The groomer at the store cannot cut cat nails, so that that was not an option.  Terrible experience and not a way to treat animals. If you care about your animals and your time, don't bring them here. If they can't even manage appointments, who knows what else they are incapable of.

I left this place crying today. I have been taking care of my puppy’s fur (including his undercoat) since February when I bought him! I explained more than once today that: Please, don’t shave or damage his fur! I said he’s 11 months and everybody knows that Pomeranian fur is not fully grown until 1 year - 2 years old! I said everything: he needs a sanitary trim, bath, nails and that’s it! I got a call from the groomer saying that she needed to charge me more because of his undercoat was matted. That’s impossible as I have been brushing him almost everyday. When I got back there I saw that this groomer took all of my beloved dog’s undercoat out right before the winter!!!!! I can’t still believe she did that!! Of all things that could go wrong I never expected that the groomer would remove my dog’s undercoat. Everybody knows the importance of the undercoat to regulate dog’s temperature during the winter and summer. I would never expected that the groomer would take all my dog’s protection!!! Yes, I’m still in disbelief about what happened. The fur of my dog is gonna take MONTHS and MONTHS to grow back!!!! Don’t take your pom there. I never asked to take his undercoat out, never. I brush him, I bath him, I take good care of my dog and you groomer messed all of his fur. That’s absurd. I will never take my pom to this place again. I don’t recommend this groomer. My dog’s birthday next month and his fur looks terrible now. I’m very sad about what happened. I’m glad I stopped her before she damaged his undercoat even more.
My pup isn't the easiest to deal with and I greatly appreciate their willingness to get his nails done quickly and painlessly!
